title: Frequently asked questions
description: Everything you need to know about Hospeda: how it works, for tourists, hosts, editors, partners and more.

hero.title: Frequently asked questions
hero.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about Hospeda. If you don't find what you are looking for, just write to us.

about.title: About Hospeda
about.subtitle: What we are and how the platform works.

what.question: What is Hospeda?
what.answer: Hospeda is a tourism portal focused on the Uruguay River coast and the Litoral Entrerriano region (Argentina). We bring together accommodations, events, destinations and articles in one place so travelers and hosts can find each other without complicated middlemen.

coverage.question: What area do you cover?
coverage.answer: We focus on the Uruguay River coast and the Litoral Entrerriano region. Browse Destinations to see the places currently listed on the site.

cost.question: How much does it cost to use Hospeda as a tourist?
cost.answer: You can browse without paying or creating an account. Check traveler plans for current prices, features, and limits.

languages.question: What languages does the site support?
languages.answer: The site is available in Spanish, English, and Portuguese. Change the language in the header or mobile menu.

different.question: How are you different from Booking, Airbnb or other big platforms?
different.answer: Hospeda focuses on regional tourism and combines listings with local events and guides. You arrange bookings and payments directly with providers.

scope.question: Is Hospeda only for accommodations?
scope.answer: No. Explore accommodations, food and drink, experiences, destinations, events, and guides to plan your trip.

verified.question: Do you verify the accommodations that get published?
verified.answer: Hospeda moderates listings, but that does not guarantee availability or verify every detail. Check with the host before booking and use Contact to report inaccurate information.

tourists.title: For tourists
tourists.subtitle: Search, book and enjoy your stay.

search.question: How do I search for accommodation?
search.answer: In Accommodations you can filter by destination, type, capacity, price, and amenities. Switch to Map view to locate options, and check your dates with the host.

booking.question: Can I book directly through Hospeda?
booking.answer: Hospeda helps you get in touch. Use the inquiry option on the listing to ask about availability. Confirm the booking, price, payment method, and cancellation terms directly with the provider.

contactOwner.question: How do I contact a host?
contactOwner.answer: Open the listing and use the inquiry option. The listing shows the available options. If prompted, sign in to send your message.

reviews.question: Are the reviews real?
reviews.answer: Reviews are written by signed-in users and published after moderation. Hospeda does not verify a booking for every review or let hosts respond publicly.

favorites.question: Can I save accommodations as favorites?
favorites.answer: Sign in and use the heart on the listing. Open Favorites in My Account to revisit saved places and organize them into collections if your plan allows it. Check the plan catalog for current limits.

issue.question: What do I do if I have a problem with an accommodation?
issue.answer: For a problem with your stay or booking, contact the host. If you find an error in the listing or on the site, use Contact and include the link to the accommodation.

petFriendly.question: Are there pet-friendly accommodations?
petFriendly.answer: Yes. The search filters include a "Pet-friendly" toggle that narrows results to available options. Some may have restrictions (size, count), so check the accommodation conditions.

events.question: How do I find events in the area?
events.answer: The Events section lists parties, festivals, fairs, concerts and activities organized by category, date and destination. It's a great way to plan your trip around something you care about.

cancellation.question: How do cancellations work?
cancellation.answer: Each provider sets its own terms. Ask about deadlines, fees, and refunds before confirming. If you need to cancel, contact the provider who confirmed the booking.

plans.question: Where can I see what each traveler plan includes?
plans.answer: You can browse without an account. The traveler plan catalog compares current features and limits, including options for saving favorites, accessing offers, and contacting providers.

assistant.question: What can I do with AI chat?
assistant.answer: When a listing offers AI chat, you can ask about the place and its services. The chat does not confirm bookings. Verify prices and availability with the provider.

writeReview.question: How do I leave a review?
writeReview.answer: Sign in and use the review form on the listing. Describe your experience and avoid including personal information.

owners.title: For hosts
owners.subtitle: How to publish, plans and managing your property.

publish.question: How do I publish a listing?
publish.answer: Choose Publish in the menu and select accommodation, food and drink venue, or experience. Sign in, create a draft, and complete the requirements shown in the editor before publishing.

cost.question: How much does it cost to publish?
cost.answer: Check the host plan catalog for current prices, trial terms, and features. If you are eligible for a trial, it starts when you publish.

commission.question: Do you charge commission on bookings?
commission.answer: Hospeda does not collect or process payments for your guests' bookings. Your Hospeda subscription and any add-ons you purchase are billed separately.

ready.question: What information do I need to create my listing?
ready.answer: Prepare a main photo, a description, guest capacity, minimum stay, room and bathroom counts, and the location. The editor shows what is missing before you can publish.

manageReviews.question: How do I manage the reviews guests leave?
manageReviews.answer: Approved reviews appear on the listing. My Reviews shows the reviews you wrote, not the ones you received. Check your account's Help Center for available reading options; hosts cannot currently reply to reviews.

featured.question: Can I feature my property or rank higher in search results?
featured.answer: Check the host plan catalog and Add-ons in My Account for available promotion options. A promotion does not guarantee first place in every search.

pause.question: What if I want to pause my listing?
pause.answer: In My Accommodations, open More actions on the listing card and choose Unpublish. The listing becomes a draft. You can republish it if it meets current requirements. Unpublishing does not pause your trial or charges.

payments.question: How do I get paid by guests?
payments.answer: You define the payment method (cash, transfer, MercadoPago, etc.) and collect directly from the guest. Hospeda does not take any cut of booking payments.

support.question: Do you offer host support?
support.answer: My Account includes a Help Center for hosts. For help with a listing or subscription, use Contact and include the listing link or a description of the problem.

billing.question: How do I pay for or cancel my subscription?
billing.answer: Authorize your Hospeda subscription payment in Mercado Pago. To review or cancel a subscription, open the subscriptions section in My Account. Booking payments are arranged separately with the provider.

contributors.tagline: If you want to add content
contributors.title: For editors and contributors
contributors.subtitle: Articles, photos, events: how to contribute to the community.

writeArticle.question: I want to pitch an article, how do I do it?
writeArticle.answer: Use the form to join as an editor. Tell us the topic and angle, and include links to previous work if you have them. Submitting a proposal does not confirm publication.

submitPhotos.question: Can you publish photos I've taken in the area?
submitPhotos.answer: Use the photo contribution form and tell us where the photos were taken. Only submit material you have the right to share, and agree on credit and usage before publication.

submitEvent.question: How do I submit an event or activity?
submitEvent.answer: If you have permission to create events, use New event in My Account. To suggest one, use Contact and include the name, date, venue, and an official link if available. Suggesting an event does not guarantee publication.

paid.question: Do you pay for contributions?
paid.answer: Submitting a proposal does not create a payment commitment. If your contribution requires payment, say so in the proposal and agree on terms before you start.

placeReviews.question: Can I write reviews of places and restaurants?
placeReviews.answer: To share your visit, sign in and use the review form if the listing has one. To pitch an editorial article, use the editor form.

program.question: Do you have a photographer or writer program?
program.answer: The form to join as an editor accepts writing and photography proposals. Tell us what you do and share links to your portfolio.

languages.question: Do you accept contributions in English or Portuguese?
languages.answer: Include your proposal's language and intended audience in the editor form. The site is available in Spanish, English, and Portuguese.

partners.tagline: If you have a brand or institution
partners.title: Partners and advertising
partners.subtitle: Advertising, sponsoring and building partnerships.

advertise.question: How can I advertise on Hospeda?
advertise.answer: Fill out the sponsorship form in Join Us with your brand's goals and the audience you want to reach.

formats.question: What banner or sponsored content formats do you offer?
formats.answer: Use the sponsorship form to tell us if you are interested in brand placement, sponsored content, or a campaign. Ask about availability and terms for the format you want.

tourismOffices.question: Do you partner with tourism boards or municipalities?
tourismOffices.answer: If you represent a municipality, chamber, or tourism office, use Contact to tell us about your regional project and whom we should speak with.

eventSponsorship.question: How does event sponsorship work?
eventSponsorship.answer: If you want to sponsor an event, use the sponsorship form to describe the event, its dates, and the placement you want. Submitting the form does not confirm placement on the event page.

officialPartner.question: Can I appear as an official partner?
officialPartner.answer: You can apply as a partner from Join Us. Check the partner pricing page to see what each current plan includes. Applying does not activate a plan or publish a profile.

commercialContact.question: Who do I contact for commercial matters?
commercialContact.answer: Use Contact for general business inquiries. If you know what kind of partnership you want, use the corresponding form in Join Us.

minBudget.question: Do you have a minimum advertising budget?
minBudget.answer: For a campaign, share your budget and ask about terms in the sponsorship form. Partner plan prices are published separately.

partnerships.question: How do I ask about a partnership?
partnerships.answer: Use the contact form to tell us about your organization and proposal. If you want to offer services to other businesses, Join Us also has a service provider form.

needAccount.question: Do I need an account to use Hospeda?
needAccount.answer: You do not need an account to explore the site or subscribe to the newsletter. Sign in to save favorites, leave reviews, or publish a listing.

deleteAccount.question: How do I close my account?
deleteAccount.answer: For now, account closure is handled by our support team: email info@hospeda.com.ar or use the Contact page to request it. If you have a subscription, we cancel it first; if you published listings, we delete them; and finally we close the account: we replace your name, your email and your phone numbers, and we shut off your access. If Mercado Pago has not yet confirmed the cancellation of your subscription, closing the account waits for that confirmation. We keep the payment receipts, because the law requires us to. The reviews you left may stay published, without your name.

dataStored.question: What data do you store about me?
dataStored.answer: It depends how you use the site: for example, sign-up details, favorites, or messages sent through Hospeda. The Privacy Policy explains what is processed and why.

themeLanguage.question: How do I change the language or dark mode?
themeLanguage.answer: Use the language and theme controls in the header or mobile menu. Your browser remembers your preferences.

paymentSecurity.question: Is my payment data secure?
paymentSecurity.answer: You authorize subscriptions in Mercado Pago, not in a Hospeda card form. Never send card details in messages or through the contact form.

newsletter.question: How do I subscribe or unsubscribe from the newsletter?
newsletter.answer: Subscribe using the form at the bottom of the site. To stop getting the newsletter, use the unsubscribe link in the email.

privacy.question: Where can I review how my data is used?
privacy.answer: See the Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy in the site footer. You can also open your cookie preferences there.

support.tagline: If you need to reach us
support.title: Support and contact
support.subtitle: Channels, hours and emergencies.

channels.question: What are the contact channels?
channels.answer: The Contact page has the contact form and current email, phone, and WhatsApp details.

hours.question: What are your hours?
hours.answer: Monday to Friday 9 to 18 (UTC-3, Argentina time). Saturday 10 to 13. Closed on Sundays and holidays. Emails and forms are answered within 24 business hours.

whatsapp.question: Do you have WhatsApp?
whatsapp.answer: Yes. The WhatsApp link and support hours are on the Contact page.

urgency.question: What if I have an emergency outside hours?
urgency.answer: For a booking problem, contact the provider you booked with. For a problem with the platform, use Contact; it is not an emergency service.

freePhone.question: Do you have a toll-free number?
freePhone.answer: There is no published 0800 number. Check the Contact page for the phone number, or use the form if you prefer to write to us.

press.question: What if I'm from press or media?
press.answer: Use the Contact page. Include your outlet, topic, and deadline if you need a response for publication.

stillNeedHelp.title: Didn't find what you were looking for
stillNeedHelp.subtitle: Write to us directly. A real person answers, not a bot.
